segments.name: Wholesale and Distribution
segments.description: Develops and distributes wholesale accessories, vape devices, and lifestyle products through an asset-light drop-ship model.
segments.evidence: one reportable segment that develops and distributes wholesale accessories, vape devices, and lifestyle products (the "Wholesale Segment")

segments.name: Digital Asset
segments.description: Manages the company's digital asset treasury through acquisition, staking, and validator participation activities related to BERA.
segments.evidence: one segment that manages the Company's digital asset treasury (the "Digital Asset Segment")

revenueModel.text: Wholesale segment generates revenue from sales of accessories, vape devices and lifestyle products; Digital Asset segment generates revenue from staking and validator participation activities.
revenueModel.evidence: In the Digital Asset Segment, the Company's digital asset investments are maintained and managed to make a return on investment through validation and staking activities to generate revenue.

changes.text: In October 2025, the company transitioned from a traditional wholesale and distribution model to a digital asset treasury strategy centered on BERA, creating a new Digital Asset segment.
changes.evidence: In October 2025, we undertook a substantial strategic transition from a traditional wholesale and distribution operating model to a digital asset treasury strategy centered on BERA
